title: Manage one local preview
responsibility: Keeps one preview running and reuses it when the same app starts again.

inputs.name: PreviewServerService.constructor.port
inputs.description: Loopback port used to reserve the one preview slot.

inputs.name: PreviewServerService.run.identity
inputs.description: Fingerprint of the checkout and selected history data.

inputs.name: PreviewServerService.run.start
inputs.description: Starts the preview only after this process owns the slot; returns its URL and cleanup function.

outputs.name: PreviewServerService.run
outputs.description: The preview address and whether another process already owned it.

outputs.name: PreviewServerService.close
outputs.description: Releases only this process’s preview and ownership listener; a reusing process leaves the owner running.
